description: Computer Surface Cloudflare OS projection — a localadmin/token-authorized, tenant-scoped, read-only projection of held actions and observations.

capabilities.description: The Computer Surface OS projection route and read-only contract tests pass.

install.instruction: Computer Surface OS projection tests must pass before enabling the surface.

capabilities.description: Optional server-side tenant binding. When set, the Computer Surface projection is limited to this tenant.

install.instruction: Set `KYBERION_TENANT=<tenant-slug>` for tenant-scoped Computer Surface data; leave unset for public observations only.

capabilities.description: Trusted human principal required whenever the Computer Surface projection is tenant-scoped.

install.instruction: Set `KYBERION_COMPUTER_SURFACE_PRINCIPAL=human:<operator>` whenever KYBERION_TENANT is set; the route fails closed without it.

capabilities.description: Optional HTTP(S) URL shown when held actions require human decision or apply.

install.instruction: Set `KYBERION_OS_GUARDED_SURFACE_URL=https://...` to provide the human decision surface link.
